sources: https://www.reservevaparks.com/Web/#!park/15 (US eDirect API prod-va-rdr.recreation-management.tylerapp.com: search/grid for facility 86 Red Oak Campground and search/details for each of its 32 units, start date 2027-05-04, read 2026-10-20)

hookups.source: https://www.dcr.virginia.gov/state-parks/james-river (Red Oak Campground: 'Electric and water hookups'; 'All sites have electric pedestals, which have 20-, 30- and 50-AMP outlets'), read 2026-10-20; reservevaparks.com site details: all 31 electric/water sites list Electric Hookup 50 and Water Hookup

values.note: Red Oak Campground: 30 shaded electric/water sites (the booking site lists 31) for tents, pop-ups and RVs up to 40 ft, with wide driveways for bump-outs; 5 are pull-through on the booking site. Two vehicles per site. The park's other campgrounds are primitive tent-only (Branch Pond, Canoe Landing, Walnut Grove) and equestrian (Horseshoe, 9 sites). Red Oak is not on the river.

sites.source: https://www.dcr.virginia.gov/state-parks/james-river ('Red Oak Campground (30 sites)', 'RVs) up to 40 feet') + reservevaparks.com search/details per site (PullInTypeName: 5 Pull Through), read 2026-10-20

facilities.source: https://www.dcr.virginia.gov/state-parks/james-river ('Full-service bathhouse with hot showers', 'Coin laundry facility, two washers and two dryers', 'The dump station is free for overnight camping guests'), read 2026-10-20

values.note: 'Camping reservations are highly recommended, and all campgrounds are site-specific.' Walk-ins may take an open site: 'Campers without a reservation (i.e., walk-ins) should ensure a site is available before submitting payment at the pay station.' The booking site gives a 14-night maximum on each campsite.

booking.source: https://www.dcr.virginia.gov/state-parks/james-river (Camping) + reservevaparks.com search/details ('MaxStay': 14 on all sites), read 2026-10-20

summary: Confirmed reservable (site-specific) with a 14-night max, walk-ins allowed at the pay station, and the $37 electric/water rate on the booking site (fees left as human-checked 2026-10-12; season already manual, matches 'first Friday in March to the first Monday in December'). Added 50-amp electric and water, 30 sites to 40 ft with 5 pull-throughs, showers/laundry/dump. Not stated: sewer (one booking-site record lists a sewer hookup, not used), booking window or cutoff for this park.
